articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $302.6M Revenue in Q3 2026, EPS at -$0.21
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $302.64 million with an earnings per share loss of $0.21, offering a key financial benchmark for the broader FEC and bowling-entertainment sector. Investors and operators can use these figures to gauge consumer demand trends across upscale bowling and entertainment venue concepts. The results highlight ongoing cost pressures even as top-line revenue remains robust for large multi-unit FEC operators.

articles.title: ESAC Uses Shanghai WUNPARK Case Study to Outline 2027 FEC Design Trends
articles.summary: Industry design firm ESAC is drawing on the Shanghai WUNPARK project to illustrate a major shift in FEC strategy: moving from attraction-mix venues to social destination concepts. The analysis highlights how curated social spaces, experiential retail, and F&B integration are becoming essential components of competitive FEC design heading into 2027. FEC operators planning renovations or new builds will find the trend breakdown directly applicable to their capital planning.

articles.title: TwinkleTwinkleStar and Ventola Projects Partner to Upgrade Party Room Entertainment
articles.summary: TwinkleTwinkleStar has announced a collaboration with UK-based Ventola Projects to transform conventional FEC party rooms into immersive, revenue-generating attractions using interactive LED lighting, wireless audio, and optional video displays. The patent-pending multisensory system is designed to increase the perceived value of party packages and drive incremental revenue per booking. For FEC operators, this represents a low-footprint upgrade path for one of their highest-margin revenue segments.

articles.title: BrushBoarding Waterless Surf Experience to Debut Full-Size Ramp at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: BrushBoarding, a waterless surfing attraction designed for FECs, leisure venues, and brand activations, will showcase a full-size ramp at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Orlando this November. The competitive socialising concept emphasizes skill-building, repeat visits, and fitness, making it a strong candidate for operators seeking differentiated attractions that drive guest retention. FEC buyers attending IAAPA can experience the attraction firsthand at booth W1058, with limited demo spots available.

articles.title: "Masha and the Three Bears" IP Launches Its First Family Entertainment Center Concept
articles.summary: The globally recognized children's IP "Masha and the Three Bears" is entering the physical attraction space with its first branded family entertainment center. This move signals continued momentum in IP-licensed FEC concepts as operators look to differentiated, recognizable brands to drive awareness and repeat visitation. FEC developers and operators should watch this rollout closely as a model for mid-tier IP licensing deals in the children's entertainment segment.

articles.title: Premiere Cinemas Adding Large Family Entertainment Center to South Plains Mall Location
articles.summary: Premiere Cinemas is expanding at South Plains Mall in Lubbock, Texas, by adding a substantial family entertainment center to its existing cinema footprint. The move reflects the growing trend of cinema operators diversifying into broader FEC attractions to combat declining box office traffic and increase dwell time. For FEC operators and suppliers, this represents both a competitive development and an example of the cinema-to-FEC conversion opportunity in retail mall spaces.

articles.title: KWICKFUN Mobile Platform Consolidates Admissions, Payments, and Access Control for Attraction Operators
articles.summary: KWICKFUN's Tap & Pay mobile app turns a single handheld device into a complete operational platform covering admissions, access control, guest payments, and transaction management, eliminating the need for fixed infrastructure at every attraction point. The system supports both credit and debit cards as well as proprietary game and house cards through Adyen integration, giving operators a unified payment ecosystem. For FEC operators managing multiple revenue touchpoints across a venue, this kind of infrastructure-free flexibility can meaningfully reduce capital and operational overhead.

articles.title: Complete Sports and Management India Secures Two New FEC Project Contracts
articles.summary: BSE-listed Complete Sports and Management India (CSML) has won contracts for two new family entertainment center projects, signaling continued FEC investment momentum in the Indian market. The company's publicly traded status makes these contract wins a trackable indicator of FEC sector growth in South and Southeast Asia. Suppliers and investors eyeing emerging market FEC expansion should monitor CSML's pipeline as a leading indicator of regional development activity.

articles.title: Bowling Alley Reopens Driven by Community Nostalgia and Local Investment
articles.summary: A bowling alley in Ozaukee County is being reborn thanks to community nostalgia and new local ownership, illustrating how legacy FEC concepts can be revitalized with the right operator mindset and community connection. The story highlights the enduring appeal of bowling as a social anchor in smaller markets where large-format FECs may not be viable. Operators considering acquisitions or repositioning of existing bowling assets will find this a relevant case study in community-driven demand.

articles.title: Magic Playground's 'Programmable Venue' Concept Turns a Single Footprint into Multiple Revenue Streams
articles.summary: Magic Playground has developed a walkable LED floor system embedded with water fountains, lights, and sensors that can be reconfigured on demand into a splash pad, interactive game arena, light show, or event stage. The "Programmable Venue" concept directly addresses the FEC industry's challenge of single-use attractions sitting idle during off-peak hours and off-seasons. For operators looking to maximize revenue per square meter, this multi-modal attraction model offers a compelling alternative to traditional fixed installations.

articles.title: Nickelodeon Playtime Jakarta Redefines IP-Based Indoor Play with Mission-Driven Experiences
articles.summary: Nickelodeon Playtime in Jakarta has reimagined the children's indoor play center by embedding beloved IP characters into mission-based, narrative-driven play across slides, trampolines, climbing walls, and obstacle courses for ages 2-11. The concept moves beyond drop-off playground models by designing for shared family participation and emotionally engaging repeat visits. FEC operators and developers building or refreshing children's play concepts will find the narrative-integration strategy directly applicable to their own IP licensing and design decisions.

articles.title: LOFIL Hybrid Play and Sports Hub Targets Both Families and Young Adult Trend-Play Audiences
articles.summary: LOFIL Play & Sports Energy Hub is a modular indoor play concept designed for commercial mall environments that blends traditional children's play equipment with trend-art installations, light sports, and original IP to serve both family and young adult demographics. The model directly addresses a common FEC gap by designing for audiences beyond families with young children, expanding the revenue-generating demographic window. The full-chain solution from space planning through operations management positions LOFIL as a potential turnkey partner for mall-based FEC operators.

articles.title: Registration Opens for Ride Camp Safety Conference 2027 in San Antonio
articles.summary: International Ride Training has opened registration for the Ride Camp Safety Conference 2027, running February 1-5 in San Antonio, Texas, billed as a premier professional development and safety education event for the amusement and water park industry. FEC operators and ride attraction managers should consider this conference a key training opportunity for frontline and management staff responsible for guest safety compliance. Early registration is advisable given the event's reputation as a focused, hands-on safety education forum.

articles.title: ISE 2027 Spark Event Expands to Larger Venue, Deepening Focus on Technology and Themed Entertainment
articles.summary: Spark 2027, the themed entertainment and technology crossover event within ISE, is moving to a larger venue at Fira Montjuïc in Barcelona on February 3-4, reflecting growing industry interest in the intersection of AV technology and immersive attraction design. FEC operators and suppliers sourcing projection, display, and interactive technology will find Spark a valuable complement to IAAPA for evaluating emerging solutions. The expanded footprint suggests stronger supplier participation and more demonstration opportunities than prior years.

articles.title: Memoir Creative Expands Experience Business, Names Kevin Kreczko Chief Growth Officer
articles.summary: Memoir Creative, an Orlando-based destination and experience creation company, has appointed Kevin Kreczko as Chief Growth Officer as it expands its integrated creative, fabrication, and production services to theme parks, cruise lines, and live event operators. Kreczko brings senior experience from RWS Global and Bass Pro Shops, adding entertainment and retail destination expertise to the firm's leadership. FEC developers and large-format operators seeking a full-service creative and production partner should take note of Memoir's expanded capabilities.

articles.title: Pensacola's New Pelican Indoor Entertainment Complex Opens to the Public
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment complex called The Pelican has opened in Pensacola, Florida, representing a local market entry in the growing regional FEC space. New venue openings in secondary markets like Pensacola signal continued consumer appetite for indoor entertainment options beyond major metros. FEC operators and suppliers tracking market penetration in the Southeast US will want to monitor this venue's format and attraction mix.

articles.title: Merlin Entertainments Moving to Virtual Queue System for Accessible Guests in 2027
articles.summary: Merlin Entertainments will upgrade its Ride Access Pass system in 2027 to allow users with accessibility needs to queue virtually via a mobile app, reducing time spent waiting in physical queues. The shift reflects a broader industry movement toward app-based queue management that improves guest experience for all visitors while reducing operational friction at attraction entry points. FEC operators with queue-dependent attractions should watch this rollout as a signal of where accessible guest experience standards are heading.

articles.title: Minecraft Moonlight Trail Takes IP-Based Location Entertainment Outdoors After Dark
articles.summary: Supply + Demand Studio, in collaboration with Microsoft and Mojang Studios, has created Minecraft Experience: Moonlight Trail, a 60-minute outdoor nighttime walk-through attraction that physically immerses guests in Minecraft biomes without relying on screens or handheld devices. The experience uses environmental storytelling and technology embedded invisibly into the landscape, pushing the boundaries of location-based IP entertainment. FEC operators exploring outdoor nighttime activation strategies and IP licensing partnerships will find this concept a noteworthy benchmark for guest immersion and repeat visitation potential.

articles.title: SimEx-Iwerks Extends BBC Earth Partnership, Adds Two New 4D Film Experiences
articles.summary: SimEx-Iwerks has renewed its long-term licensing agreement with BBC Studios and developed two new 4D Experiences based on the BBC's Mammals series, available to attraction operators worldwide starting March 2027. The partnership keeps BBC Earth's high-quality natural history content flowing into the global network of 4D cinema and attraction installations. FEC operators running 4D theaters or considering adding film-based attractions should evaluate the new Mammals titles as proven, licensable content from a trusted supplier.

articles.title: Wisconsin Pub Installs Indoor Golf Simulators to Drive Winter Revenue
articles.summary: A pub in Beloit, Wisconsin has added indoor golf simulators as a winter revenue strategy, joining a growing wave of food-and-beverage venues incorporating simulator sports to extend seasonal appeal. This grassroots adoption of golf simulator technology illustrates the low barrier to entry for FEC-adjacent operators and signals continued consumer demand for active, skill-based indoor entertainment. FEC operators considering golf simulator additions as an F&B-integrated revenue stream will find this a timely real-world example.

articles.title: Bean Sprouts' Imaginibbles Menu Concept Turns Kids' F&B Into Part of the FEC Experience
articles.summary: Bean Sprouts, a kids-focused café concept operating inside family destinations across the US, has developed Imaginibbles, a playfully themed children's menu designed to make nutritious food choices engaging and adventurous for young guests. By transforming the dining moment into an extension of the overall entertainment experience, the concept addresses a persistent FEC challenge of delivering F&B that resonates with both children and health-conscious parents. FEC operators looking to elevate their kids' dining program and increase per-cap F&B spend should explore this as a licensing or partnership opportunity.

articles.title: Winner's Circle FEC Marks Two Years in Longmont with Regional Awards and Anniversary Deals
articles.summary: Winner's Circle, an indoor entertainment center in Longmont, Colorado, is celebrating its second anniversary with regional recognition and promotional offers, providing a local success story for mid-market FEC operators. Two-year milestones are a meaningful survival benchmark in the FEC industry, and the regional recognition signals that the venue has built genuine community loyalty. Operators in secondary markets can draw encouragement and tactical inspiration from how Winner's Circle has established its position.

articles.title: Fun Spot America Launches Black Friday Season Pass Sale for 2027
articles.summary: Fun Spot America's Orlando and Kissimmee parks are offering significant discounts on 2027 season passes and ultimate season passes from November 13 through November 30 as part of a Black Friday promotional campaign. Season pass promotions timed to Black Friday have become a standard revenue-acceleration tool for FEC and amusement park operators heading into the slower winter period. Operators can benchmark Fun Spot's promotional structure as they design their own holiday pass and membership campaigns.

articles.title: Hershey Super Sweet Adventure Shows How CPG Brands Can Anchor Immersive Location-Based Experiences
articles.summary: Original X Productions developed an entirely original narrative world for the Hershey Super Sweet Adventure, demonstrating that consumer packaged goods brands without existing fictional canon can still support compelling, story-driven immersive attractions. The project offers a replicable framework for FEC operators and experience developers working with non-entertainment brand partners who want to create location-based activations. This case study is especially relevant as more CPG and lifestyle brands explore experiential retail and branded entertainment partnerships.

articles.title: Moment Factory's La Serre des Mondes Transforms Legacy Attraction into Gamified Walkthrough Experience
articles.summary: Moment Factory's La Serre des Mondes at Futuroscope converts a dated 360-degree projection building into a multi-room, gamified walkthrough experience accommodating 60-80 guests per 16.5-minute cycle across four immersive spaces. The project is a strong case study in how attractions operators can cost-effectively repurpose legacy infrastructure with layered interactive narrative design rather than costly demolition and rebuild. FEC operators with aging anchor attractions should study this renovation approach as a path to reinvigorating guest interest and per-visit dwell time.

articles.title: New Indoor Entertainment Park and Music Production Studio Opens in Local Market
articles.summary: A new business combining an indoor entertainment park with a music production studio has launched in a local market, representing an emerging hybrid venue model that pairs active entertainment with creative studio experiences. The concept reflects a broader trend of FEC operators differentiating through unique secondary programming that attracts diverse demographic segments beyond traditional family groups. Operators exploring non-traditional FEC programming pairings will find this hybrid model worth watching.
